The main takeaway from our work is that
flow modification of the A1 segment-ACoA can be achieved by ipsilateral A1 segment clipping, and it is a safe and feasible alternative to clip reconstruction in difficult cases.

the flow modification of the A1 segment of ACA and ACoA complex can facilitate the clip reconstruction of giant ICAb aneursyms, with the additional advantage of reducing the number of vessels to be clipped and the complexity of reconstruction.
